headlines.detail: On track after lap 1 · most: VER (10)

summary: George Russell won the Chinese Grand Prix Sprint from pole position, 0.7s ahead of Charles Leclerc, with Lewis Hamilton completing the podium.
Liam Lawson made the biggest climb, from P13 to P7.
Isack Hadjar had a day to forget, dropping from P10 to P15.
The race was neutralised by 1 safety car.
The stewards penalised ANT (10 second time penalty) and PER (5 second time penalty).
There were 12 pit stops in total; the winner stopped once.
George Russell leads the championship by 11 points over Kimi Antonelli.
